dct_description_sm: At top of map: London Magazine 1778.
Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.

Covers Connecticut as far west as Guilford and Farmington; Massachusetts extending west to the Connecticut River Valley and north to Boston, including Cape Cod, Martha's Vineyard, and Nantucket; and the eastern end of Long Island.
From The London Magazine: Or, Gentleman's Monthly Intelligencer (November, 1778), vol. 67.
Publication statement: [London] : London Magazine, 1778.; [London] : Printed for R. Baldwin at the Rose, Pater Noster Row, 1778.
